meta.title: [FEATURE] 1回のextractionで複数のcommentを処理する
meta.body_summary: Process multiple comments in a single LLM extraction request to reduce processing time and OpenAI rate limits, with batch extraction logic in extraction.py.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added batch extraction but couldn't resolve Ruff lint errors; maintainer closed after agent was unresponsive to CI failures, despite adding tests and multiple lint fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 635 changed lines across 10 files (primarily test additions), this is a moderate refactor by absolute volume. It fits a batch-processing performance feature but was closed—not merged—because the agent failed to resolve CI lint errors and maintainer judged the agent ineffective.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer nasuka requested tests for new batch functions; later nishio asked for status. Devin added tests but repeatedly failed to resolve Ruff linter E402 (module-level import not at top of file), causing CI failures. After multiple lint-fix commits, agent could not make CI green.
review_details.performance_claim: Process multiple comments in one extraction request to reduce processing time and OpenAI rate limits.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed after multiple failing lint-fix attempts, stating Devin did not seem to be working; PR link saved for future reference.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent struggled to resolve Python linting requirements (Ruff E402) and import mocking for tests, revealing limitations in handling project-specific lint rules and CI integration.

detection_detail.code_reading: nasuka reviewed implementation and requested tests for batch functions.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI pipeline flagged lint errors (Ruff) which Devin attempted but failed to fix.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmark or before/after metrics provided; only informal claim of 'processing speed improvement'; test steps exist but CI could not pass.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After repeated unsuccessful lint fixes, maintainer closed PR with note that Devin wasn't working; link added to original issue.

core_change_summary.description: Implemented batch extraction logic in extraction.py to process comments in groups of 5, updated extractionPrompt.ts for multi-comment format, extended parse_json_list.py to handle new JSON response structure, and added tests with import mocking.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files added with significant line count; merge from main introduced unrelated files (page.tsx, Chart.tsx, READMEs, admin_report.py) which are not part of the performance change.

Subsequent commits: linting fixes (Ruff), test addition, import mocking attempts.
Multiple cycles of Ruff formatting/linting fixes that did not resolve CI errors.
Maintainer merged main and added noqa comments but CI remained failing.
PR closed after maintainer declares Devin not working.
